# Supporting Reliable Dining Operations Through Long-Term Partnership


[Corporate](https://www.hcsgcorp.com/blog/category/business/corporate/) ,


[Dining](https://www.hcsgcorp.com/blog/category/dining/)


Since 2011, Healthcare Services Group and[Sysco](https://www.sysco.com/) have partnered to deliver consistent, high-quality dining operations for the long-term and post-acute care communities HCSG serves nationwide.


Sysco is the global leader in selling, marketing, and distributing food and related products to customers who prepare meals away from home, including healthcare organizations, restaurants, educational institutions, and other foodservice environments nationwide. Healthcare Services Group provides dining and nutritional services across the entire post-acute-care continuum and the behavioral health sector in communities nationwide.


From the beginning, HCSG and Sysco forged a partnership based on a shared commitment to growth, service excellence, and reliability. During this time, Sysco invested heavily in technology and reporting infrastructure, aligning closely with HCSG’s priorities of purchasing transparency, operational visibility, and data accuracy for client partners.


As HCSG expanded its dining operations, the partnership with Sysco enabled greater consistency and scalability in procurement and food distribution.


**Supporting Consistency Across Dining Operations**


Today, Sysco supports HCSG’s dining operations by sourcing and distributing a wide range of food products across all dry, cooler, and freezer categories, and facilitating access to bread, bakery items, dairy, and produce through local vendors as needed.


This partnership helps HCSG maintain reliable dining operations by providing consistent product availability, dependable delivery, and robust nationwide distribution support. Sysco’s continued investments in transportation and inventory management have minimized outages and maintained high fulfillment rates, contributing to smoother operations and greater predictability for the communities HCSG serves.


For HCSG client partners, this collaboration fosters consistency in menus, meal service, and product availability— key elements for stable daily operations and positive resident experiences.


**Investing in Long-Term Growth Together**


What sets this partnership apart is a shared agility to adapt operations in pursuit of long-term scaling, leveraging dedicated teams with sector-specific expertise.


Sysco’s ongoing investments in technology and reporting enable HCSG teams to monitor purchasing trends, enhance operational visibility, and identify opportunities for greater efficiency across HCSG accounts. Their commitment to a safe, secure supply chain helps to ensure that quality and compliance are not compromised.


Looking ahead, both organizations remain focused on supporting the long-term care sector through expanded product offerings, improved reporting capabilities, and collaborative planning tailored to evolving operational needs.


For over a decade, the HCSG-Sysco partnership has shown long-term collaboration, shared operational standards, and a commitment to reliably strengthening dining operations for healthcare communities nationwide.
